main.title: About me
main.description:
I'm a creative developer with a focus on front-end development and user experience. I enjoy building interactive and user-friendly digital products that combine strong design with functional code.

My work is centered around translating ideas into working prototypes using modern technologies like React, while applying UX principles such as research, testing and iteration.

My goal is to create digital experiences that not only look good, but also truly connect with users and solve real problems.
